messages:
incident_bot: INCIDENT ALERT @channel — spike in 5xx gateway errors for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Alerting on-call. Pager triggered.

anya_sre: seeing ~8% 5xx at the gateway for gen path, p95 latency jumping from 180ms -> 1.2s. Errors are mostly 502/504 and some 5xx from backend. Customers reporting timeouts.

matt_research: curious if it's the model servers or the KV routing layer. I see a sharp rise in cache miss ratio for prefix-cache on a subset of shards. Miss rate went from 2% -> 42% in last 6m.

sara_oncall: paging in. I have the runbook open: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-prefix-cache-5xx — starting checks. Any recent deploys?

jules_eng: no user-facing deploys in the last hour. We did change cache prefetch config 2 hours ago (prefetch_concurrency=8 -> 16). Reverting maybe?

liam_support: multiple customers on enterprise tier saw timeouts; CS is triaging tickets. ETA for mitigation?

anya_sre: quick triage — tailing gateway logs shows backend tls handshakes failing intermittently with ECONNRESET to kv-proxy on specific host pool: kv-proxy-3f2b. Also seeing JSON parse errors from prefix-cache layer ("null value for expected object").

ops_bot: autoscale event: +3 model-inference instances launched in us-west-2 at 3332110500.

sara_oncall: ok doing immediate mitigation: 1) pause prefetch (to reduce load), 2) route 10% of traffic to fallback cold reads, 3) coordinate with infra to drain kv-proxy-3f2b. Doing commands now.

jules_eng: command snippets:
```
# pause prefetch via feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/prefetch_concurrency -d '{"value":0}'

# enable fallback route
rbctl route update --service gateway --route /v1/generate --fallback-cold-read 10
```

matt_research: logs from kv-proxy-3f2b show repeated cache tombstone responses ("key:xyz -> TOMBSTOONE_MARKER") and a subsequent attempt to deserialize into model-routing metadata which fails. Might be corruption from a previous compaction job.

anya_sre: llstack trace snippet from gateway:
```
err=\"json: cannot unmarshal null into Go struct field Route.meta of type routes.Metadata\"
  at gateway/handler.go:142
  at prefixcache/reader.go:87
```

liam_support: flagging enterprise customers A123 and B234 with a heads-up. They want a status update in 15m.

sara_oncall: progress update: paused prefetch flag applied (confirmed), fallback cold reads 10% enabled. Draining kv-proxy-3f2b now (marking as admin-drain). Error rate dropped to ~4.5% after fallback. Still elevated but stabilizing.

jules_eng: infra suggests re-run compaction verification and apply a conservative repair that replaces tombstones with explicit missing-value markers for affected shards. This will be a risky operation — needs coordination and brief traffic steering.

matt_research: +1 on careful repair. Also let's increase cache TTL temporarily to avoid aggressive eviction churn while we repair: set prefix-cache.ttl.default=120s -> 600s.

sara_oncall: applying TTL bump and asking infra to hold compaction until after business hours unless we need emergency fix.

ops_bot: ticket created: INC-2026-4987 — "KV shard tombstone corruption causing gateway 5xx" assigned to eng-ml + infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4987

anya_sre: quick mitigation checklist we followed:
- paused prefetch to lower sustained cache writer pressure
- enabled 10% fallback cold reads to reduce immediate 5xx impact
- drained suspected kv-proxy instance and routed traffic off shard group
- bumped TTL to reduce eviction churn
- opened INC ticket and engaged infra for repair plan

liam_support: CS notified customers, comps team requested logs — shared partial logs and ETA for next update 3332111400.

matt_research: note — if anyone needs to debug locally, you can replicate the JSON null error with this curl against the staging prefix cache harness:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-cache.redwood.internal/read -d '{"prefix":"abc123","expect_metadata":true}' | jq .
# you'll see the null for meta field
```

anya_sre: monitoring dashboard panels: error-rate panel, gateway->kv latency heatmap, prefix-cache miss ratio. Adding temporary alert to trigger if 5xx > 3% for 5m.

sara_oncall: handoff — I'm going offline in 30m but will stay reachable via phone if repair goes live. @anya_sre will take primary on-call. @jules_eng please coordinate infra repair steps and hold change window.

jules_eng: understood, will coordinate and avoid compaction until we have a safe plan. We'll try an isolated repair on the worst-affected shard first (shard-09b) and run validation jobs.

anya_sre: next update scheduled at 3332111400. Current status: impact reduced, errors trending down but not fully resolved. Postmortem will include root cause analysis and follow-ups: stronger tombstone validation during compaction, prefetch backpressure circuit, and automated shard-level drain when JSON-deserialize errors observed.

liam_support: customers acknowledged. Thanks team. :heart:

incident_bot: Incident state: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to Sev-2 at 3332112200. Follow-up: assign postmortem to eng-ml + infra + platform by 3332116000.
